description: This file defines a Go package 'mo' for handling GNU gettext MO files, including loading, parsing, and serializing MO file data, with structures for messages and headers.

classes.name: File
classes.description: Represents an MO file with metadata and messages.

methods.name: Load
methods.description: Loads MO file data from a byte slice.

methods.name: LoadFile
methods.description: Loads an MO file from a specified file path.

methods.name: Save
methods.description: Saves the MO file to disk.

methods.name: Data
methods.description: Returns the MO file data as a byte slice.

methods.name: String
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the MO file in PO format.
